nonvacuity: scratch/Nonvacuity.lean compiles an infinite iid U[0,1] experiment, WholeSieveData with Y=m=V=0, and the zero least-squares fit for every degree cap. For all remaining hypotheses take shifted normalized Legendre polynomials, J(n)=floor(n^(1/4)) and c=1/2: orthonormality and the K^2 envelope give E||G-I||_F^2 <= (K^3-K)/n, hence Gram stability by Markov; J tends to infinity and both required dimension rates vanish. Full mathematical verification is in scratch/AuditNotes.md. The infinite orthogonality/rate/Gram portion is argued, not claimed compiled; Mathlib has no ready analytic Legendre-orthogonality API in the inspected file.

scratch/Nonvacuity.lean constructs a probability measure on the countable product of the exact four-atom law, measurable X and Y, IID pairs and the exact required first-pair law. It also checks normalization of the changed-marginal law at q=1/4. Both covariate atoms have positive mass, conditional probabilities are 1/4 and 3/4, the Bernoulli family is normalized and positive on its binary support, and the clipped empirical mean is a genuine unique measurable MLE. The printed-reading conditions and regularity checks are listed individually in scratch/AuditNotes.md.

scratch/Nonvacuity.lean constructs genuine normalized Dirac conditional kernels with real density 1, checks finite section entropy, finite expected log and self-KL zero, and compiles one example simultaneously satisfying every hypothesis of the consistency conjunct: actual iid law, measurable singleton-valued estimator, nonnegative vanishing error, separation, uniform convergence and exact product maximization. A nontrivial compact Bernoulli parameter-family instance is also justified mathematically in scratch/AuditNotes.md.

scratch/Nonvacuity.lean proves MixtureAdmissible ![1/2,1/4,1,sigma,0,1,1] for every sigma>0, checks strict positivity of the three sample entries and a positive normal density. The genuine path has L >= C/sigma with C=exp(-5)/(32 sqrt(2*pi))>0; sigma=C/(abs(B)+1)>0 exceeds any bound B while every admissible likelihood is finite. Every condition of the printed unrestricted-mixture reading is checked individually in scratch/AuditNotes.md.
